ops.text: No lump-sum quote exists and none is needed: Advanced is paid on measured dockets at the rates on its weekly Commercial Approval sheet (clean $10/m, braced for scrim $24.40/m, vehicle gate $50, pedestrian gate $61, demarcation CCB $5.40/m, installer and relocation labour $100/h, team leader $200/day), approved week by week against a purchase order each: 4647508 wk6 $8,992; 4647509 wk5 $33,670; 4647517 wk4 $26,695; 4647515 wk3 $50,154; 4647519 wk2 $28,246.50. Over or under is read docket by docket against the programme on the Fencing tab.

No separate customer rate. The V8s are charged fencing per metre at the 2026 street card (clean $16.16, scrim $25.53, relocation $8.65, ped gate $36.18, CCB event $7.51, demarcation $13.08) and event people at the Event Labour Scope roles (fence team $88.49/h). Advanced's $200/day team leader is inside our cost of each week's approval sheet, not a line to the customer. Rule applied 15 Oct 2026.

Read against the programme weeks to 14 Oct: braced-for-scrim is booked under Clean with the bracing as components (36581 S04 corporate: 58 panels braced, no metres), so it is not missing; relocation is on the green service notes as hours (24469, 24471, 24474), not metres; removal is CON WK1 and the DECON weeks, still to do, with no docket metres by design; gates: Advanced's week 2 sheet carries 33 vehicle and 3 pedestrian gates on 36574-36590 held here as wheels, the rest are CON WK1 (50 + 21) and Event Week; CCB flat feet 42 of 45 for WK2 done, 121 m is Event Week.

Working rule until iEDM writes the key: a window is the time the closure is in force (closed at its start, clear by its end: Fri 7-8am and 6-7pm, Sat 7-7.25am and 5.53-7pm, Sun 7-7.25am and 5.15-7pm); the two marks sharing an order number are the two ends of one section and close together; the colour is the crew running that section (black, orange, teal, pink). Basis: the 19 Sep photograph (circled numbers = order, Andrew 19 Sep) and the 5 Oct review.

Cost basis on the record: Kyle Gover and Daniel Gough are Job Connect labour hire, costed from the purchase orders (Kyle $3,023.70 w/e 20 Sep and $1,299.74 w/e 27 Sep; Daniel $3,052.60 w/e 4 Oct); Aaron Zelvis, Alfie Harris, Jayden Paul, Wayne Crimmin, Frank Devilles and Ludwig Chee are Coates staff on salary, whose cost rate is a payroll figure the 30 Sep finance review left blank. Kyle's records without hours are shifts from 15 Oct on, not yet worked; hours go on after each shift.

Alfie's nightly rate on the record is $223.63 ex GST (14-17 Sep and 6-9 Oct; the 21-24 Sep stay was $176.04 and 28 Sep-1 Oct $248.78). Nights from 12 Oct are planned at $223.63 until the invoice says otherwise; a night is only a cost once it is stayed.

Not short by error: WC09 asks for 10 FWF on Andrew's word of 14 Oct (4 received 8 Oct, 6 more to come on an Event Portables run); WC30 asks for 8 (Schedule 9, Event Week 19 Oct) and 4 arrived 15 Oct (0681, 0043, 0963, 0545). Both close as the rest arrive.

9961976: line 41 distribution board and line 47 cable are supplied with the generators and are inside the card rate (the card prices 200 kVA with cables); line 45 is a spare 60 kVA, Pending, no charge unless called off; line 37 tyne rotator, Pending, no charge unless delivered. Nothing to enter.
